display_name: Direxion Daily 20+ Year Treasury Bull 3X Shares

about.en: TMF is the Direxion Daily 20+ Year Treasury Bull 3X Shares ETF, a leveraged exchange-traded fund sponsored by Direxion that seeks 300% of the daily performance of the ICE U.S. Treasury 20+ Year Bond Index before fees and expenses. Because the leverage resets daily, returns compound and can diverge substantially from 3x the index's performance over periods longer than one day. It is listed on NYSE Arca and is not a direct holding of US Treasury bonds.
